findings.highlight: I believed that since it was something I could do, it was something I must do.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分に出来る事だから、やらなくてはいけない事だと信じたから
findings.governingReading: He chose to fight because it was something he could do, and because he believed it something he had to do: two parallel grounds.
findings.explanation: Two grounds for choosing to fight become capability implying duty.
